# Google Scholar

> > Google Scholar provides free access to scholarly literature across disciplines, including articles, theses, books, abstracts, and court opinions from academic publishers, professional societies, universities, and other scholarly organizations.

Google Scholar is a comprehensive academic search engine that indexes scholarly content from multiple sources, enabling researchers, students, and academics to discover peer-reviewed papers, citations, and legal documents. The platform offers advanced search capabilities, citation tracking, and metrics to facilitate academic research and literature review.

## Key Topics

- academic-search
- scholarly-articles
- research-database
